jobs.title: Risk Analyst 6 Month FTC
jobs.description:
**Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?**

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

MUFG, a globally respected financial institution, is seeking a Risk Analyst for a six-month fixed term contract in Riyadh. This is an exceptional opportunity to join the Risk Management Department and play a pivotal role in supporting the branch’s risk governance framework. You will be part of a knowledgeable team that values professionalism, teamwork, and personal growth, all within an inclusive and supportive environment. MUFG is renowned for its commitment to integrity, responsibility, and client-centric principles, offering you the chance to contribute meaningfully while developing your skills through training opportunities and flexible working arrangements. If you are looking for a role where your expertise will be valued and your development supported, this position offers the perfect platform to advance your career in risk management.

**What you'll do:**

* Assist the Head of Risk Management in monitoring Credit Risk (including Concentration Risk and Country Risk), Market and Liquidity Risk, Operational Risk (excluding IT/System related technical risks), Product & Service Risk Management, Vendor Risk frameworks according to MUFG’s Global Comprehensive Risk framework and local regulatory guidelines.
* Conduct daily monitoring of market, liquidity, delivery, and other risks by reporting exposures and escalating breaches as per internal procedures to ensure robust oversight.
* Review deals conducted by the Market Products (Treasury) Team including positions, profits, and off-price transactions to maintain accurate records and compliance.
* Support pre-signing/pre-disbursement due diligence of facilities by gathering relevant data and inputting facility information upon signing, activation, amendment or deletion of credit lines across all systems.
* Organise and conduct assigned risk-related committees such as MALCO and CRMC by preparing materials and keeping stakeholders informed on regulatory matters.
* Maintain updated internal bank rules and regulatory documentation relating to Risk Management for sharing with department heads and branch management.
* Assist in credit portfolio monitoring activities by providing support for credit risk assessments and middle office operations as directed by the Department Head.
* Keep important documents organised within the department and vaults to ensure secure storage and easy retrieval when required.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of the Operational Risk Framework within the branch by identifying areas for enhancement and supporting implementation efforts.
Participate in analysis and approval processes for new products (APA), offering insights from a risk management perspective while serving as back-up to the Head of Risk Management during absences.  

**What you bring:**

* A proven track record in risk management within foreign exchange or money market business at financial organisations operating in KSA/GCC regions demonstrates your dependability.
* Experience working in Treasury Middle Office or Credit Risk Middle Office operations within KSA/GCC financial institutions highlights your collaborative approach.
* An excellent understanding of diverse risk categories—including credit risk, market risk, liquidity risk, operational risk (excluding IT/system risks), accounting/tax—ensures you can connect complex concepts effectively.
* Skilled use of Microsoft Excel alongside broader Microsoft Office suite enables you to manage data accurately while sharing insights with colleagues.
Familiarity with Temenos T24 banking system is considered advantageous for efficient workflow integration.  

  

**What sets this company apart:**

MUFG stands out as one of the world’s leading financial institutions with an unwavering commitment to integrity, responsibility, client-centricity, and people-focused principles. The Riyadh Branch offers an inclusive environment where collaboration is encouraged across all levels—ensuring every team member feels connected and supported. Training initiatives are regularly available so you can continue growing professionally while expanding your knowledge base within a dependable network. The company’s supportive leadership fosters communal achievement rather than individual competition—making it an ideal place for those who value teamwork over hierarchy. With access to global resources yet rooted firmly in local expertise within Saudi Arabia’s dynamic financial sector, MUFG provides both stability and opportunity for personal advancement.

**What's next:**

If you are ready to take the next step in your career journey with MUFG Riyadh Branch as a valued member of their collaborative team—apply now!

Apply today by clicking on the link provided.

  

This advert will close 9th December 2026

We are open to considering flexible working requests in line with organisational requirements.

MUFG is committed to embracing diversity and building an inclusive culture where all employees are valued, respected and their opinions count. We support the principles of equality, diversity and inclusion in recruitment and employment, and oppose all forms of discrimination on the grounds of age, sex, gender, sexual

jobs.title: Real Estate Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

* Identify suitable properties that meet the Bank’s operational requirements and coordinate activities related to leasing, purchasing, and selling real estate.
* Develop proposals and supporting documentation concerning property sales, rentals, and management for review and approval by the Bank’s management.
* Carry out approved decisions and initiatives related to real estate leasing, sales, and property management.
* Maintain effective cooperation with real estate agencies, property valuation companies, and other relevant external partners.
* Identify opportunities to reduce and optimize the Bank’s costs associated with renting and acquiring properties.
* Contribute to the administration and ongoing management of the Bank’s real estate portfolio.
  

**Job Details Experience**
--------------------------

  

* Good understanding of legislation and regulatory requirements governing real estate management, administration, and procurement activities within the banking sector.
* Knowledge of real estate management practices, rental arrangements, and procedures for working with property valuation companies.
* Proficiency in using computer applications and modern tools for processing and managing information.
* Strong analytical abilities, including the capacity to review information, assess relevant details, and support well-informed decisions.
* A responsible, diligent, and results-driven approach to work, with a strong focus on meeting objectives and maintaining a client-oriented mindset.
  

About Company:
  
STYLO, We believe in innovation, excellence, and teamwork, offering a vibrant and fast-paced environment where talent is nurtured and growth is encouraged.Join us to be part of a brand that is shaping the future.

**Job Category:** Office

**Job Type:** Full Time

**Job Location:** Dubai

jobs.title: Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
**Property Consultant / Investment Consultant: Dubai Real Estate (Off-Plan & Secondary)**

Storeys Real Estate is hiring experienced sales professionals for a high-activity outbound sales role in Dubai. If you have a cold calling background in Real Estate, EdTech or IT Sales, are comfortable making 250+ calls a day, and can join immediately, we'd like to hear from you.

**About Storeys**  
Storeys is one of Dubai's fastest-growing real estate companies, built on ethics, transparency and discipline. In just one year, we have crossed AED 1 Billion in GTV.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Make 250+ outbound cold calls per day to generate qualified leads
* Follow up with leads and convert them through calls, meetings and property presentations
* Negotiate and close deals with investors and end-users
* Give clients market insights and investment guidance on off-plan and secondary properties
* Build and maintain long-term client relationships
* Update the CRM daily
* Consistently meet and exceed monthly sales targets

**Requirements**

* 1 to 5 years of sales experience with active cold calling (mandatory)
* Background in Real Estate, EdTech or IT Sales (Banking or Insurance sales is also considered)
* Proven ability to handle 250+ dials per day
* Ability to join immediately
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Target-driven, resilient and self-motivated
* Working knowledge of CRM and MS Office
* Freshers and interns will not be considered

**Preferred**

* UAE sales experience
* Knowledge of the Dubai property market and developers

**What We Offer**

* Fixed monthly salary plus uncapped commission
* Company-provided leads
* UAE employment visa and medical insurance
* Premium developer portfolio
* Structured training and mentorship
* Fast-track career growth
* Ethical, high-performance work culture

**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE (on-site)

**How to Apply**  
Apply directly through Indeed, or email your CV to malavika.vikraman@storeys.ae  
Walk-in interviews contact: +971 54 191 7882

Pay: AED3,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* How many calls did you make per day in your last role?

Experience:

* Cold calling: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Financial Analyst - BP&A
jobs.description:
**Job Requisition ID:** 183504

About Al-Futtaim
  
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

  

**Overview Of The Role:**
  
The Financial Analyst role is crucial for supporting the strategic financial operations within the Retail Finance division of Al-Futtaim Group. The position involves assisting in strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting. It requires proactive communication with various business units and efficient management of information to deliver timely and accurate financial insights. The Analyst will work closely under the supervision of the BP&A Team, playing a vital part in driving automation and supporting project management activities.

**What You Will Do:**

#### **Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting**

* Assist the BP&A Team to manage the Strategic Plan, Budget, and Forecasts.
* Ensure accurate and timely completion of planning responsibilities.

#### **Reporting, Financial Analysis, Contingency Planning**

* Assist the BP&A Team to prepare and circulate regular and ad-hoc reports and financial analysis.
* Ensure accurate and timely completion of reporting responsibilities.

#### **Automation / Projects**

* Assist the BP&A Team in project-related activities, focusing on automation and efficiency improvements.
* Ensure accurate and timely completion of automation and project responsibilities.

#### **Administration**

* Provide administrative support to BP&A Head and Team.
* Ensure timely provision of required support to the team.
  

**Required Skills To Be Successful:**

* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical and planning skills.
* Good business acumen.
* Ability to develop and maintain healthy relationships with colleagues.
  

**What Qualifies You For The Role:**

* Commerce graduate with 4 years of experience in finance systems.
* Working knowledge of budgeting and financial/management reporting.
* Experience in the Middle East, preferably in the retail sector.
* Proficiency with accounting software packages, preferably ERP such as SAP, and good MS Office skills.
  

About Al-Futtaim Retail

At Al-Futtaim Retail, we are part of a 90-year legacy built on ambition, progress and long-term vision. As one of the region’s leading retail operators, we partner with some of the world’s most trusted brands – including IKEA, ACE, Marks & Spencer and the Inditex Group – bringing global excellence to customers across MENA and Southeast Asia.

We don’t just operate stores; we shape retail experiences. From launching brands like Watsons and Kiabi to our regions for the first time, to investing in digital innovation, AI capabilities, the customer experience and loyalty platforms, we are constantly redefining the future of retail.

With over 100 nationalities spread across more than 10 countries, our strength lies in our diverse and collaborative community. Here, you’re equipped to turn your ambition into action, building the career you want, while helping us move retail forwards.

Join us and be part of The Heart of Tomorrow.
